_note: module_a's lid is opened and reclosed directly without ever being moved to stow_zone. stow_a_lid never completes and is not condition-skipped (jar profile has_lid:true), so it surfaces as a 'skip' violation at the sink (close_container) — and, because it is one of close_container's own unmet prerequisites, close_container's own completion also reports out_of_order. Both are expected: the immediate attempt and the retrospective miss are two different signals about the same missing step.
